civilopediaText.text: Mazapan, or marzipan, is a confection consisting primarily of sugar and almond meal, sometimes augmented with almond oil or extract. - Wikipedia

quote: Mazapan isn't merely a confection, but a tool. Mighty multitool, marvelous moxie, malicious malady, you name it! Nothing is outside the reach of our mighty almond treat, and the world will know soon enough.
